stories.title: Ethiopia accuses Eritrea of sending troops into Tigray, demanding an immediate withdrawal
stories.reason: Witnesses reported Eritrean soldiers in trucks moving through Adigrat toward the front near Idaga Hamus days after the two countries severed diplomatic ties, raising fears that a month-old war between Addis Ababa and Tigrayan forces is pulling in a neighboring army.

stories.title: Israel marks three years since the October 7 attack with nationwide memorials and renewed political tension
stories.reason: Commemorations at more than 400 sites, including the Nova festival grounds, came three weeks before an election where opposition figures are pressing Netanyahu over his refusal to allow a state inquiry into the government's failures on that day.

stories.title: Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi among 260 detained as Delhi police block an opposition march
stories.reason: The Congress leaders occupied a government building for over eight hours demanding to meet election commissioners over a voter-roll revision they say has wrongly purged eligible voters, before being detained and later released as police filed charges over the unauthorized entry.

stories.title: McDonald's is hit with a federal antitrust lawsuit over its AI menu-pricing tool
stories.reason: A proposed nationwide class action filed in Illinois alleges the machine-learning system, which pools sales data across nearly 14,000 US restaurants, amounts to unlawful price coordination among independently owned franchisees under the Sherman Act.

stories.title: AMD says it will substantially increase chip supply in 2027 to meet AI demand
stories.reason: CEO Lisa Su, visiting Taiwan suppliers including Foxconn and TSMC, said AMD is now planning three to five years out to line up wafer, packaging and memory capacity together, even as tight high-bandwidth memory and a looming power shortfall threaten to become the industry's next bottleneck.

stories.title: Waymo upsizes its first-ever private loan to $5 billion to fund global robotaxi expansion
stories.reason: Goldman Sachs arranged the debt, which grew from an initial $3 billion target with Pimco, Blackstone and Sixth Street as lenders, as Alphabet's self-driving unit looks to fund entry into Japan and Singapore alongside rising AI compute costs without further diluting shareholders.

stories.title: Microsoft and Nvidia unveil RTX Spark-powered Surface PCs built for running AI models locally
stories.reason: The new Surface Laptop Ultra and a developer-focused Spark Dev Box pair a 20-core Grace CPU with up to 128GB of unified memory, enough to run roughly 120-billion-parameter models on-device, as Dell, Lenovo and Asus prepare rival machines on the same Nvidia platform.

stories.title: McKesson and CD&R agree to take Option Care Health private in a $5.8 billion deal
stories.reason: McKesson will pay about $1.4 billion for a 49% stake in the country's largest independent infusion-therapy provider, with an option to later buy out CD&R's remaining share, at a 37% premium that sent Option Care shares up nearly 33%.
